data.description: A left-to-right row of exhibits teaching polyform's math/chance randomness, one subgraph per lesson placed directly at the root: (1) every value is a hash of (Seed, Key), so raising Tutorial/Count adds cubes without moving the existing ones; (2) SeedNode labels give unrelated streams from one seed; (3) the same 20 fractions through nine distributions, each chart drawing its curve, one Bar Chart run For Each; (4) weighted kinds with RandomIndexNode, a keep-out mask through a per-element SelectNode and GroupNode; (5) jitter, cone directions and inside-sphere points by composing a vector RandomNode with Uniform3DNode, Compose3DNode, DirectionNode and InsideSphereNode; (6) correlated values from RandomNodes sharing one seed and keys; (7) seeded Perlin noise. Lessons that color by kind draw from Tutorial/Palette.
data.name: Random Tutorial

bar_chart.name: Bar Chart
bar_chart.description: One bar per value in Fraction, each bar's height read from Distribution there with SampleNode. Run For Each over a list of distributions to compare their shapes on the same fractions.

instanced_model.name: Instanced Model
instanced_model.description: One mesh in one colour drawn at every transform by GPU instancing; an empty list draws nothing. Run For Each over groups to give each group its own mesh and colour.

lesson_correlated.name: Lesson 6 - Correlated Values
lesson_correlated.description: Values that must move together share a seed and keys. Two RandomNodes given the same keys and seed draw the same stream, one through Uniform for the height and one through Power for the radius, so the tall capsules are the fat ones. RandomBoolNode on its own seed stream flags about 30% of them, and FilterNode keeps only those transforms for the flag.

lesson_directions.name: Lesson 5b - Directions in a Cone
lesson_directions.description: 30 sticks rooted at one hub, each pointing along a unit vector drawn by a vector RandomNode over DirectionNode (Axis +Y, Cone Angle in degrees). RotationToNode turns the stick's +Y onto each direction.

lesson_distributions.name: Lesson 3 - Distributions
lesson_distributions.description: Nine bar charts on a board, read like text: Uniform, Normal (clamped at 3 deviations), LogNormal, Exponential, Power, Triangular, Ramp, Discrete, Constant. Every chart reads the same 20 evenly spaced fractions, 0.025 to 0.975, through SampleNode, so each draws its curve: the value at fraction u is what a random draw lands below u of the time. Only the Distribution fed to Bar Chart differs. One Bar Chart runs For Each over the list of distributions.

lesson_jitter.name: Lesson 5a - Jitter by Composition
lesson_jitter.description: There is no jitter node; jitter is a random transform multiplied onto each slot. A 5x5 grid of cubes is offset by a vector RandomNode over Uniform3D (+-Jitter in X and Z), turned about Y by a vector RandomNode over Compose3D of a Uniform angle, and sized by a float RandomNode over LogNormal. trs.NewNode builds the local transform and the lifted trs.MultiplyNode applies it to every slot. Each draw has its own SeedNode label.

lesson_keys.name: Lesson 1 - Keys & Seeds
lesson_keys.description: Every random value is a hash of (Seed, Key). IntegersNode numbers Count slots, those numbers place the cubes at a fixed spacing, and a float RandomNode turns each (Seed, index) into a height through a Uniform distribution. Raise Count: new cubes appear on the right and the existing ones keep their heights and places.

lesson_kinds.name: Lesson 4 - Weighted Kinds
lesson_kinds.description: A 6x6 grid of slots, each given a kind (sphere, cube, cone, empty) by RandomIndexNode in proportion to its weight. A keep-out: a lifted CompareNode on each slot's |X|, ANDed with "not empty", drives a per-element SelectNode that writes -1 over the kind, which GroupNode drops. One Instanced Model runs For Each over the kind groups with one mesh and colour each.

lesson_noise.name: Lesson 7 - Seeded Noise
lesson_noise.description: A field of columns whose heights come from Perlin2DNode sampled at each column's (x, z). Noise is smooth where random draws are not: neighbours get similar heights. Its Seed picks a different patch of noise, so the same field with another seed is a different landscape.

lesson_sphere.name: Lesson 5c - Points Inside a Sphere
lesson_sphere.description: 200 dots at positions drawn by a vector RandomNode over InsideSphereNode: spread evenly through the volume, not bunched at the centre.

lesson_streams.name: Lesson 2 - Seed Streams
lesson_streams.description: One master seed, several unrelated streams. The cubes reuse lesson 1's (Seed, index) heights exactly; a second stream derived by SeedNode with the label "color" picks one of four colours per cube with RandomIndexNode, GroupNode sorts the cubes by colour, and one Instanced Model runs For Each over the groups.

Cone Angle.description: Lesson 5b: degrees the sticks may lean from +Y (0-180).

Count.description: How many cubes lessons 1 and 2 draw (1-24). Raising it adds cubes on the right; the existing ones keep their heights, because each value hashes (Seed, Key).

Jitter.description: Lesson 5a: half-size of the box each grid cube may be offset within (0-0.1).

Noise Seed.description: Lesson 7: seed of the Perlin noise; the right-hand field always uses this seed + 1.

Palette.description: The colors every lesson draws its kinds from, in order: a lesson with N kinds uses the first N.

Seed.description: Master seed for every lesson. Change it and every random value changes; keep it and nothing moves.

Cone.description: Lesson 4: relative weight of a cone in a slot (0-5).

Cube.description: Lesson 4: relative weight of a cube in a slot (0-5).

Empty.description: Lesson 4: relative weight of an empty slot (0-5).

Sphere.description: Lesson 4: relative weight of a sphere in a slot (0-5).
